rationale: FX02 flags fair_value_currency values of U_USD as non-USD, but the raw schedule of investments presents the fair value column in dollar-denominated form. Representative flagged holdings show dollar signs in the principal, amortized cost, and fair value columns, including Neutron Holdings, Inc. with fair value $30,090 and Eclipse Buyer, Inc. with fair value $27. The source therefore supports USD-denominated fair values; U_USD is a source/unit-label alias issue in the check, not a real non-USD data error.
